children: Canada is exploring all options under the Investment Canada Act to consider nationalizing steel maker Stelco, owned by US-listed Cleveland Cliffs
, Industry Minister Melanie Joly said on Friday in Toronto.

"We believe there has been multiple breaches of commitments (by Cleveland Cliffs) and section 40 of the ICA offers options through a court process to make sure the company obliges to the commitment made," Joly said
